newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police prevent Turks and Kurds fighting.
newsitem.headline: German police prevent Turks and Kurds fighting.

text.p: Around 75 Turks and Kurds were detained in the German city of Cologne on Thursday night to prevent a pitched battle between rival supporters of a Turkish and a Kurdish soccer team, police said on Friday.
Police said the two groups were armed with knives and baseball bats and had been hurling insults at each other and squaring up for a brawl after a local league match.

Most of the men were released overnight. Police said the violence had its origin in fights that broke out on Wednesday as Turkish fans celebrated a victory over the Netherlands by their national side.
Kurds make up about a fifth of Germany's population of more than two million Turks.
German police attribute dozens of attacks on Turkish properties in the last few years to Kurds sympathising with militants in Turkey who are waging a guerrilla war for Kurdish secession.
